originality.rationale: The original algorithm and its reciprocal-square cap relation are explicitly credited as established. The new science is its sharp complete prime-two orbit family, open exact-startup interval and transverse absorbing dynamics. Full primary HTML inspections reveal convergence proofs and the cap identity but no mathematically dominating explicit classification; another related paper discusses empirical cycling with a different update and leaves rigorous analysis open. The result remains best-knowledge originality, not an independently guaranteed uniqueness claim.

value.rationale: A full continuum (not an isolated unstable witness) of nonconvergent adaptive stepsizes arises under exact normal initialization on the simplest strongly convex optimization problem, with a sharp nontrivial cubic frontier imposed by the growth safeguard. The invariant family has a transverse zero eigenvalue and a neutral tangent; this quantifies stable algorithmic parameter cycling while primal optimization contracts. This information matters for analyzing stepsize stabilization, diagnostics and extrapolations. It is neither a renamed source lemma nor a routine objective-convergence corollary. Applicability is explicitly restricted to the original scalar update.
